exposure: Doppler parameters (UA-S/D, UA RI, UA PI, MCA PI, MCA RI)
outcome: predictive value of Doppler parameters for adverse pregnancy outcomes
cohort: 50 women with high-risk pregnancies in their third trimester referred for Doppler ultrasound at GITAM Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, Vishakhapatnam, between January 1, 2023 and December 31, 2023.
finding: Multi-vessel color Doppler ultrasound was found to be a valuable tool for monitoring patients at risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, outperforming the umbilical artery pulsatility index (UA PI) alone.
